name: scoutlens
description: ScoutLens - football scouting & fantasy analytics over the Big 5 European leagues (MySQL + Express + React)

scripts.db:migrate: node etl/run-sql.js db/migrations && node etl/run-sql.js db/logic
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:schema && npm run db:import && npm run db:logic
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
